plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)

browser.name: OpenVibe Companion
browser.api: https://openvibe.coupons (OpenVibe.Coupons public API), https://openvibe.network (the Dock's state), https://openvibe.chat (the Dock's Chats tab)
permissions: sidePanel (Chrome only; Firefox needs no permission for sidebar_action)
browser.credential: optional cpx_ install token (coupons.lookup, coupons.report); the Dock one-click OAuth public client (scopes dock, activity, chat.read; access in storage.session, rotating refresh in storage.local); the 0.7.0 pasted OpenVibe token is still accepted as a fallback until a later release
browser.loadedInChrome: yes: headless Chromium loads the build (popup and options render, no console errors); lib/autoapply.js passes three fixture checkout pages in headless Chrome; the one-click Dock sign-in is covered by test/auth.test.js
browser.loadedInFirefox: not yet loaded in a browser; Mozilla's web-ext lint (8.10.0, what AMO runs on upload) passes with 0 errors, 0 warnings and 0 notices, and runs in CI with warnings as errors
handoffs: https://openvibe.reviews/save (a review site's rating, checked and saved on Reviews)
browser.storeBuilds: npm run pack:stores: dist/openvibe-companion-<version>-chrome.zip and -firefox.zip, reproducible, audited
browser.storeListing: store/ (listing, privacy and permission answers, screenshot plan); support URL https://openvibe.coupons/companion
features: OpenVibe Dock one-click sign-in: public OAuth client companion (PKCE S256, no secret), read-only scopes dock/activity/chat.read, access token in storage.session, rotating refresh token in storage.local, Sign out revokes the family, the account page lists it under Signed-in apps

the OpenVibe Dock in the side panel (Chrome side_panel, Firefox sidebar_action): the released OpenVibe.Shared Dock (v4.57.0) bundled under browser/shared/, reading and writing the same Network state as the Dock on a site, with the same tabs (Agents, Chats, Activity); approvals/sends are hidden with the read-only scopes
pending: owner: create the Chrome Web Store and AMO developer listings and upload the store zips with store/'s answers and screenshots; the Chrome id is fixed by browser/manifest.json key
Firefox: the extension loaded and run in a real Firefox (web-ext lint passes; nothing has run it yet)
